title: WS-1: Command Center authority-freshness display (local/template only)
description: Split from retired TASK-306 per DEC-040 (operator-authorized 2026-07-30). Implement the Command Center authority-freshness display -- the 4th WS-1 Required Consumer (map-authority status/route/current-state.md already done under TASK-310) -- entirely in local template/source files, no remote Smalls write. Completes TASK-310's Command Center consumer without the cross-PC deployment risk; that work is deferred to a separate WS-6 task created when that workstream begins.
acceptance_criteria: Command Center UI displays authority host, authority revision, last successful sync time, and freshness classification (fresh/stale/unavailable), sourced from local template/server code only.
No remote write to Smalls; Smalls cross-PC deployment and parity verification are explicitly out of scope, deferred to a separate WS-6 task.
Focused tests cover fresh/stale/unavailable display states; independent core agent review before approval.
